name: Quicksilver
description: A native Metal backend for Minecraft's renderpearl layer (the MC Metal Shaders project), cut from mcopt 0.3.0-alpha.2, with mixins that let Sodium draw, Vitrail's engine run and Distant Horizons take its Vulkan paths on it. Settings: Options, Video Settings, Quicksilver (with Sodium). Properties: -Dmcms.metal.* (README.md).
